info.name: Marauder Chapter
info.description: The Marauder Chapter subclass for the Jaeger from Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024).
info.author: MonkeyDM

element.name: Marauder Chapter
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: A jaeger of the Marauder Chapter embodies raw slaughter. Vengeance, wrath, and death, all rolled into one swing that never ceases, endlessly cleaving through monsters, leaving a bloody wake of destruction. Each marauder is a symbol of the Chapter's determination and savagery, striking fear into the hearts of their enemies with their every swing. They are unstoppable warriors, driven by a thirst for vengeance and the need to protect humanity from the monstrous hordes.

element.name: Level 3: Path of Gore
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: You learn the Great Cleave Finisher. This does not count against your Finishers known.

element.name: Great Cleave
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon with the Two-Handed Property, you can expend all of your Momentum dice. When you do so, the attack deals extra damage equal to 1 Momentum die to the target, and you cleave a number of adjacent targets within Reach equal to the number of dice expended. Make a melee weapon attack against each creature targeted. You regain 1 Adrenaline Point for each creature this reduces to 0 Hit Points, up to your maximum number of Adrenaline Points.

sheet.description: When hitting with a Two-Handed weapon, expend all Momentum dice to deal +1 Momentum die damage to the target and make a melee weapon attack against a number of adjacent targets in Reach equal to the dice expended. Regain 1 Adrenaline Point per creature reduced to 0 HP.

element.name: Level 3: Marauder Momentum
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: While you are wielding a melee weapon with the two-handed property, the size of your Momentum die is increased by one step (from a d6 to a d8, to a d10 at 11th level, and to a d12 at 17th level).

sheet.description: While wielding a melee weapon with the Two-Handed property, your Momentum die becomes 1d{{marauder momentum:dice}}.

element.name: Level 3: Unbreakable
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: You wade through your enemies relying on your toughness and grit. Your Hit Point Maximum increases by 3, and it increases by 1 whenever you gain another Jaeger level.
While you are wearing Medium Armor, you can add your Constitution modifier (to a maximum of +2) instead of your Dexterity modifier to determine your Armor Class.

sheet.description: While wearing Medium Armor, you can add your Constitution modifier (max +2) instead of your Dexterity modifier to determine your AC.

element.name: Level 7: Leap Attack
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: Once per turn, if you move more than 15 feet toward a creature (or fall 10 feet or more) immediately before making a weapon attack against them, you deal extra damage on a hit equal to your Momentum die.

When falling, you can make this attack prior to hitting the ground if there is a target creature in range where you would fall. On a hit, any damage you would take as a result of falling is reduced by half, and you do not fall Prone from the fall.

sheet.description: If you move more than 15 ft toward a creature (or fall 10+ ft) before attacking it, deal extra damage equal to your Momentum die on a hit. If falling, you can attack before landing; on a hit, falling damage is halved and you don't fall Prone.

element.name: Level 14: Fell the Leviathan
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: Whenever you use a Finisher, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC = 8 + your Strength modifier + your proficiency bonus) or be knocked Prone. Creatures that are Large or larger have Disadvantage on this saving throw.

sheet.description: Whenever you use a Finisher, the target must make a DC{{fell the leviathan:dc}} Str save (Large+ creatures have Disadvantage) or be knocked Prone.

element.name: Level 17: Titanic Strength
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: Your strength is so great that you can wield a two-handed weapon in one hand, and can use Two-Weapon Fighting even when the weapons you are wielding aren't Light (including using two-handed weapons).
If you use two hands to wield a two-handed weapon, your attacks with it deal extra damage equal to half your Strength modifier (rounded up) on a hit.

Additionally, when you use a Finisher, you can double the number of Momentum dice you have (to no more than your maximum Momentum dice + 1). Once you've doubled your dice, you can't do so again until you complete a Long Rest.

sheet.description: You can wield Two-Handed weapons in one hand and use Two-Weapon Fighting with non-Light weapons (including Two-Handed). Wielding a Two-Handed weapon with two hands deals +{{strength:modifier:half:up}} damage on a hit. Once per Long Rest when using a Finisher, you can double your current Momentum dice (up to max Momentum dice + 1).
